rubric: An abstention is an arm response that yields no usable probability distribution over the item's options (missing, non-numeric, negative, non-finite or zero-mass). An abstention is never dropped. It is scored as the uniform distribution for Brier and NLL, and as incorrect at confidence 1/K for ECE, the reliability curve, accuracy, macro-F1 and selective prediction. Abstention counts are reported per arm. A run HALT (non-200, pinned-model mismatch, spend signal) is not an abstention.
